# buildBlogThemeCss

## Summary

Builds the stylesheet a blog card injects: the `.blog-scope` default token block (colors chained to the semantic theme vocabulary, wrapped in `@layer blog-defaults`) plus, when a Theme card is linked, its `cssImports` and un-layered `cssVariables` so the theme wins. Shared by BlogApp, BlogPost, and Author.

```js
import { buildBlogThemeCss, themeStyleFor } from '../blog-defaults';
```
